//ConnectionStrings: Same registry database the Packager app uses (DeployToolkit.Core.EfCore / DeployToolkitRegistry). Replace the LocalDB default with your Azure SQL / SQL Server connection string, or override via the ConnectionStrings__Registry environment variable — keep the secret OUT of source control (plan §12).
//Database: Provider=SqlServer in production (migrations live in DeployToolkit.Core.EfCore and are applied at startup). Sqlite is a local-development convenience only.
//Auth: NO credentials and NO rotation settings here — per toolkit requirement the username/password and every rotation setting (Auth.Rotation.Enabled, IntervalMinutes, PasswordLength, Usernames, LogPasswords, LastRunUtc, NextRunUtc) are stored in the ApiSettings / ApiUsers / ApiCredentialLogs TABLES of the registry database. On first run the API registers an 'admin' user with a crypto-random password directly in the database and rotates it per the DB settings. Only the per-IP rate limit (infrastructure, not a credential) stays in configuration.
